name: Ariake Isora
source:
Isora is the older sister. Her gimmick is this: she hates herself. She hates herself so deeply that it’s ingrained in her. She compares herself to things like gum stuck on the sidewalk and pigs in pens. She legitimately thinks that anything good that happens to her must have an ulterior motive, and that she deserves everything bad that happens to her.

[From Dark Eye Translations]
